about: The events a trigger of contributes.triggers runs on. Each event is about one file of the vault, which is the target of the trigger's condition and of the handler it runs. tools/events.mjs writes the Go list from this file.

events.name: file.added
events.about: a file is added to the vault, or the core finds it for the first time

events.name: file.changed
events.about: the content of a file of the vault changes
